iPhone users targeted by crypto wallet malware
Malicious ads have reportedly appeared in 47 countries, exploiting iOS vulnerabilities to steal sensitive data. Simply opening a webpage may trigger the attack, with no downloads or additional clicks required.
Devices running iOS 18 and older are reportedly affected, with MetaMask, Phantom, and Trust Wallet users among the targets.
The malware can steal:
• Crypto wallet seed phrases
• Passwords stored in iCloud Keychain
• Private messages and photos
Security recommendations:
• Update iOS to the latest available version
• Avoid storing seed phrases or passwords in Notes and screenshots
• Stay away from suspicious ads and links
• Never share your seed phrase
Check your iPhone for available updates and keep your wallet credentials secure.

The first AI Assistant Commerce Report is live!

We tested 25 AI assistants on whether they can actually buy things online. Out of 200 attempts, only 28 ended in an accepted order (14%)

Each assistant was given the same 8 tasks:
1-5. White Nike socks at Target, Nike, Dick's, Kohl's & Macy's
6. A Logitech mouse on Amazon
7. Flowers, store of its choice
8. A USB-C cable, store of its choice

No single assistant cracked them all, in fact the best one got only got 5 of 8 orders through

The report outlines where agentic shopping breaks today:

> The web is the biggest blocker. 

36% of attempts were stopped before payment by bot walls, sign-in pages and checkout flows

Agents can find the product, the store just won't let them buy it

Dick's had the most successful orders placed (16%)

Amazon failed to allow a single order to be placed (0%)

> "Order confirmed" doesn't mean the order went through. 

Macy's confirmed 5 orders, then cancelled 4

Introducing Embo. We're building the brain for intelligent robots.

Robots today are fragile outside of the situations they were trained on. We are building frontier AI models based on world models, with a deep understanding of physical reality and fine-grained motor skills.

Instead of being limited to manual demonstrations, our robot brain pretrains on internet-scale video to understand the physical world. It then practices motor skills in imagined scenarios, so robots work out of the box in unfamiliar settings.

We have raised a $110M Seed led by @a16z, with @khoslaventures, DST Global, NVentures (@nvidia), and other strategic investors.
